The '''Colunda sector''' was a subsector of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Colunda Prime]].

==History==
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the sector was repesented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Char Bibbeck]]. He was involved in a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] scandal in which he was accused of betting on which [[Planet/Legends|planets]] would secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="HNN51" />
